extracted.name: Classic Cuba Libre
extracted.description: It doesn’t get much easier than this classic Cuba libre iced cocktail recipe that’s simply made with rum, cola, and lime juice.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Fill a 12-ounce glass with ice cubes. Pour rum and cola into the glass. Stir in lime juice and serve.
